The build process consists solely of a `make install` command executed within the extracted source directory, with the destination redirected to the package directory. There are no network operations, file manipulations, or code executions outside the build context, and no use of dangerous commands like `eval`, `curl|bash`, or obfuscated scripts.

The package serves a specific, narrow purpose—handling window focus on notification click—and the build script does not deviate from standard packaging norms. All operations are transparent, auditable, and confined to the build environment. No data exfiltration, unexpected downloads, or system modifications are present or implied.
